arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى سِتْرِكَ بَعْدَ عِلْمِكَ ، وَمُعَافَاتِكَ بَعْدَ خُبْرِكَ،
transliteration: allāhumma laka al-ḥamd ʿalā sitrik baʿda ʿilmik wa muʿāfaatika baʿda khubrik
english_text: O God, to Thee belongs praise for Thy covering over after Thy knowledge and Thy pardon after Thy awareness!

arabic_text: فَكُلُّنَا قَدِ اقْتَرَفَ الْعَائِبَةَ فَلَمْ تَشْهَرْهُ ، وَارْتَكَبَ الْفَاحِشَةَ فَلَم تَفْضَحْهُ وَتَسَتَّـرَ بِالْمَسَاوِي فَلَمْ تَدْلُلْ عَلَيْهِ،
transliteration: fakullunā qadi iqtarafa al-ʿāʾibah, fam lam tashhurh war takaba al-fāḥishata fal lam tafḍaḥu wa tastaṭṭar bil-masāwī falam tadhullu ʿalayhi
english_text: Each of us has committed faults, but Thou hast not made him notorious, done indecencies, but Thou hast not disgraced him, and covered over evil deeds, but Thou hast not pointed to him.

arabic_text: كَمْ نهْي لَكَ قَدْ أَتَيْنَاهُ، وَأَمْر قَدْ وَقَفْتَنَا عَلَيْهِ فَتَعَدَّيْنَاهُ، وَسَيِّئَة اكْتَسَبْنَاهَا، وَخَطِيئَة ارْتَكَبْنَـاهَا،
transliteration: kam nahi lak qad ataynahu wa amr qad waqfatanā ʿalayhi fatataʿaddaynāhu wa sayyi'ataktasabnaha, wa khati'atuartakabnaha
english_text: How many are Thy prohibited acts which we have performed, Thy commandments of which Thou hast told us which we have transgressed, the evil deeds which we have earned, the offenses which we have committed!
Thou seest them to the exclusion of all observers;
Thou hast the power to make them public above all the powerful!

arabic_text: كَانَتْ عَافِيَتُكَ لَنَا حِجَاباً دُونَ أَبْصَارِهِمْ، وَرَدْماً دُونَ أَسْمَاعِهِمْ،
transliteration: kānat ʿāfiyatuka lanā ḥijāban dūna ʾabṣārihim waradamān doona asmāʿihim
english_text: By giving us safety Thou hast veiled their eyes and stopped their ears.

arabic_text: فَاجْعَلْ مَا ستَرْتَ مِنَ الْعَوْرَةِ، وَأَخْفَيْتَ مِنَ الدَّخِيلَةِ وَاعِظاً لَنَا، وَزَاجِراً عَنْ سُوْءِ الْخُلْقِ وَاقْتِرَافِ الخَطِيئَـةِ، وَسَعْياً إلَى التَّوْبَةِ الْمَاحِيَةِ وَالطَّرِيْقِ الْمَحْمُودَةِ،
transliteration: fa-jaʿal mā s-tart-a min al-ʿawrat-i waʾakhfayta mina al-dakhīlah waʿiẓan lanā wa zājiran ʿan sūʾi-l-khulqi wa iqtiṣāfi-l-khaṭīʾah wa saʿyān ilā al-tawbah al-māḥiyah wa al-ṭarīq al-mahmūdah
english_text: So make the shameful things Thou hast covered over and the inward reality Thou hast concealed our admonisher, a restrainer upon bad character traits and committing offenses, and a striving toward the repentance that erases [sins] and the praiseworthy path!

arabic_text: وقَرِّبِ الْوَقْتَ فِيهِ ، وَلاَ تَسُمْنَا الْغَفْلَةَ عَنْكَ
transliteration: wa qarribil waqta feehi wa lā tusumnā al-ghaflata ʿanka
english_text: Bring the time of striving near and visit us not with heedlessness of Thee!

arabic_text: إنَّا إلَيْكَ رَاغِبُونَ ، وَمِنَ الذُّنُوبِ تَائِبُونَ.
transliteration: innā ilayka rāghibūna, wa mina al-ẓunūbi tā'ibūna
english_text: Surely we are Thy beseechers, the repenters of sins.

arabic_text: وَصَلِّ عَلَى خِيَرَتِكَ اللَّهُمَّ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ مُحَمَّد وَعِتْرَتِهِ الصِّفْـوَةِ مِنْ بَرِيَّتِـكَ الطَّاهِرِينَ ، وَاجْعَلْنَا لَهُمْ سَامِعِينَ وَمُطِيعِينَ كَمَا أَمَرْتَ .
transliteration: wa ṣalli ʿalā khīyaratika allāhumma min khalqik muḥammad wa ʿitratihi al-ṣafwati min barīyatika al-ṭāhirīn wa-ajʿalna lahum samiʿīna wa-muṭīʿīna kamā amarta
english_text: And bless Thy chosen, O God, from Thy creation, Muhammad and his descendants, the friends selected from among Thy creatures, the pure, and make us listeners to them and obeyers, as Thou hast commanded!
